newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak meets envoys from Great Lakes region.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak meets envoys from Great Lakes region.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak met an envoy from President Pierre Buyoya of Burundi on Monday -- the third from the Great Lakes region in five days.
Secretary of State Leonidas Havyarimana told reporters after the meeting that he had asked Mubarak for Egyptian help for Burundi but he gave no other details.

On Sunday Mubarak met Tanzanian Foreign Minister Jakaya Mrisho Kikwete and last Thursday he saw Zambian Education Minister Siamukayumbu Siamujaye, who asked Egypt to help his country cope with an influx of Zairean refugees. Mubarak ordered that food and medicine be sent to Zambia.
African diplomats in Cairo said they knew of no special reason for the visits to Egypt, though some of the envoys may be on their way to a meeting of African foreign ministers in Libya.
Earlier this month a senior defence ministry official in Zaire said Egypt had agreed to send war material to help the Zairean army fight rebels in the east of the country.
Egypt has said it has no military ties with Zaire.
